newsitem.title: UK: Ex-Sears employee plans shoe buy-out-report.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Sears employee plans shoe buy-out-report.

text.p: Ex-British Shoe Corporation (BSC) managing director Rebecca Cotterell and her then deputy Chris Onslow are the leading contenders to buy the footwear chain from Sears Plc, Sunday Business said on Sunday.
Cotterell resigned last week, it added.
Sears Plc announced the break-up of its retail empire in April, including plans to sell the loss-hit BSC.
Chairman Sir Bob Reid told Reuters at that time that several companies were interested in BSC, including U.S. shoe retailers Nine West Group and Payless Shoesource.
Analysts doubted Sears could sell BSC at no cost, and estimated it involved a 150 to 200 million pound hit.
No one at Sears could be reached on Sunday for comment.
